references.text: Parallel text about the pig as an unclean animal because it has a split hoof but does not chew the cud, with the same prohibition against eating its meat or touching its carcass.
Detailed laws about uncleanness from touching dead unclean animals.
Prophetic condemnation of those who eat pork and other unclean food.
Judgment on those who eat pork and other unclean things.
